# HELIX test package

HELIX v0.18.0 (github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/helix) files for the starter-set types, its slots and the concerns the starter selects, used to build test plugin packages (test/fixtures/helix-release.mjs). HELIX declares the MIT licence in its plugin manifest. SKILL.md is a stand-in: the real one ships in the release package.
